{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and number who converted
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_sum = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_sum / n_loyal

# Output all values needed for evidence
print(f"n_loyal = {n_loyal}")
print(f"converted_sum = {converted_sum}")
print(f"conversion_rate = {conversion_rate}")"}
